Imagine that an American marketing company is doing research in your area about advertising by text message. You have agreed to participate in a telephone interview about commercial advertisement messages.
Question 5: How often do you send text messages in a typical day? To whom do you usually send them?
Question 6: When was the last time you received a commercial advertisement message? What kind of product or service was it advertising?
Question 7: Which do you think is a better way for companies to advertise their products and services: text messages or phone calls? Why?

Watching workers perform tasks
Having workers evaluate themselves
